exercises.name: Odwodzenie nogi w tył na wyciągu

scenes: Low cable glute kickback, ankle cuff attached to low pulley, standing on one leg with other leg extending behind, hand holds machine.
Seated shoulder press MACHINE, back supported, machine handles pushed upward above shoulders.
Seated lateral raise MACHINE, padded levers under outer elbows and arms raised sideways.
Reverse pec deck rear delt fly MACHINE, seated facing chest pad with arms spread backward horizontally.
Single arm LOW CABLE lateral raise, standing sideways to pulley, one hand lifts handle out to shoulder level.
Dumbbell shoulder shrug, athlete standing holding dumbbells with straight arms at sides, shoulders elevated.
